name: shape-form-encoded
description: Format demonstration: the body is not JSON at all. It is a form-encoded parameter string, the digest is a plain hash rather than an HMAC, and the signature is appended to the body as another parameter. PayFast ITN has this form.
notes: A format demonstration, not a verified PayFast fixture. TODO(human): PayFast urlencodes each value (spaces as +, uppercase hex) before hashing, and the passphrase is omitted entirely when the merchant has not set one — confirm both against their ITN docs. Note also that PayFast expects the receiver to post the payload back for validation; that server-to-server step is outside what this simulator exercises.
